name: Todos
description: Lists the tasks written in notes, in a widget and in a tab

extensions.title: Task lines
extensions.description: Draws a checkbox on task lines of a note, colours their due, done, rec and pri dates, priority, projects, contexts and tags, dims completed tasks, and completes projects, contexts, tags, dates and priority as you type them

functions.name: hasOpenTask
functions.description: notes with at least one open task, a - [ ] line

functions.name: hasDoneTask
functions.description: notes with at least one done task, a - [x] line

functions.name: hasTaskOverdue
functions.description: notes with an open task whose due: date is before today

functions.name: hasTaskDueToday
functions.description: notes with an open task whose due: date is today

functions.name: hasTaskDueWithin
functions.description: notes with an open task due from today to the given number of days ahead, 0 or more

functions.name: hasTaskDueBefore
functions.description: notes with an open or done task whose due: date is on or before the date, written YYYY-MM-DD

functions.name: hasTaskWithoutDue
functions.description: notes with an open task that has no due: date

functions.name: hasTaskProject
functions.description: notes with an open task of the +project, given without the plus sign

functions.name: hasTaskContext
functions.description: notes with an open task of the @context, given without the at sign

functions.name: hasTaskPriority
functions.description: notes with an open task of the priority, one letter A to Z

functions.name: hasTaskText
functions.description: notes with an open task whose text contains the text, compared without case

settings.title: Ignored folders
settings.description: Folders whose notes are not searched for tasks
settings.details: Paths from the vault root, such as templates, archive/old. A note below one of them is skipped.

settings.title: Hide task markers until the line is edited
settings.description: Hides due:, pri:, +, @ and # until the cursor is on the line
settings.details: A task line keeps its markers (due:, done:, pri:, +project, @context, #tag), but they are drawn only while the cursor is on that line.

settings.title: Overdue
settings.description: Open tasks due before today, in the widget
settings.details: Lists and counts the open tasks due before today in the popup of the widget.

settings.title: Today
settings.description: Open tasks due today, in the widget
settings.details: Lists and counts the open tasks due today in the popup of the widget.

settings.title: Next 7 days
settings.description: Open tasks due in the next days, in the widget
settings.details: Lists and counts the open tasks due in the six days after today in the popup of the widget.

settings.title: No date
settings.description: Open tasks with no due date, in the widget
settings.details: Lists and counts the open tasks with no due date in the popup of the widget.
